meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: Claude 会帮你制作一个可交互的幻灯片演示文稿，包含分页、动画、分支导航和演讲者备注。输出的是一个可直接运行的网页，不是视频。
howto.when: 当你明确要求制作幻灯片、演示文稿、交互式展示，或要求将现有页面转换为幻灯片时触发。如果请求不明确，Claude 会先确认。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于我们产品的演示文稿。
把这个页面转换成幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会保留原页面的设计和交互。

say.text: 创建一个有分支导航的互动展示。
say.note: Claude 会制作包含热点跳转的幻灯片。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create an interactive slideshow with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and presenter mode with speaker notes. Output is a runnable deck, not a video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation, interactive deck, or to convert an existing page. If unclear, Claude confirms before proceeding.

say_en.text: Create a presentation about our product.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm if you want a HyperFrames slideshow.

say_en.text: Convert this page into a slideshow.
say_en.note: Claude preserves the original design and interactions.

say_en.text: Make an interactive deck with branching.
say_en.note: Claude creates slides with hotspot navigation.
